name: imports
source:
use 'sample' Int, Byte
use self Bool
use Bool

name: module namespace imports
source:
use package.math
use package.stats as stats
main: math.answer

name: source first import selections
source:
use package.math add, sub as subtract
use '../math' add, sub

name: indented import selections
source:
use package.math
    add
    sub as subtract
main: add

name: obsolete parenthesized dependency imports
source: use package.math.(add, sub)

name: obsolete parenthesized local imports
source: use '../math'.(add, sub)

name: obsolete dotted local export imports
source: use '../math'.add

name: bracket literals
source:
empty := []
elements := [1, 2, 3]
repeated := [0; 4]

name: pointer annotations
source:
value Byte := 1
pointer @Byte := @value
write(buf @Byte) Int extern

name: references and ownership
source: f(value own Entity, other ref{root} Entity) ref{root} Entity: other

name: rebindings
source:
main:
    value: 1
    value:: 2
    value+: 3
    record.field:: 1
    items.(index)*: 2
return value

name: compile-time queries
source:
f(value Int) Int: #asm('spec', value: #register(value))
arch := #target.arch
size := #size(@Byte)
align := #alignment(Byte)
bits := #index_bits(Byte)

name: format interpolation
source: msg := "🫖 \(outer(inner(1), 'text)')) done"

name: multiline interpolation
format text and escapes
source: msg := "(name) {name} \\(name) \n"

name: comments
source:
--| module
--- documentation
x := '-- text' -- ordinary

name: ranges and predicates
source:
Byte is in 0 to 255
Positive is in 1 to 255
values := 1 to 10

name: conditionals
source:
result: when x is
    1 then 'yes'
    else 'no'

name: named results
source:
pair() left Int, right Int:
return left: 1, right: 2

name: unsupported equality
source: x := a == b

name: unsupported inequality
source: x := a /= b

name: explicit loop and if conditions
source:
run: while x is True
    consume(x)
loop
check: if x is True
    consume(x)
return

name: composed conditions
source:
check := when x is Ready and y is True then 1 else 0
negated := when not x is Ready then 0 else 1

name: literal type alternatives
source:
Digit is 1 or 2 or 3
Greeting is 'hello'

name: expression type arguments
source: values Vec(Int, 4 + 4) := make()

name: fixed-array annotations
source: fill(data [Byte; 4]) [Byte; 4]: data

name: ordinary operator precedence
source:
result := a or b and c + d * e
range := a to b to c
address := @a + b
negative := -a + b

name: generic parameter and return type
source:
identity(value t) t: value
Box(t) has value t

name: proof-bearing results
source: check(value Int) Yes thus value = 1 or No: Yes

name: constrained and defaulted type parameters
source:
Box(t has Copy) has value t
Default(t: Int) has value t
Hidden(t, count Int: ?) has value t

name: generic reference and variant result types
source:
copy(value ref t) t: deref value
Choice is Ready -> Int or Missing -> Int

name: proof operators are contextual
source: check(value Int) Yes thus value == 1 and value /= 2 or No: Yes
